neighbours.label: the possessive intensifier 'own' ('its own', 'their own'; also eigenen/propias)
fire: Each town in the valley has its own small library.
The children were allowed to choose their own books.
She finally opened her own bakery near the station.
Every student must bring their own laptop to class.
The cat has its own blanket by the fireplace.
Many families grow their own vegetables in summer.
He prefers to cook his own meals after work.
Each team designs its own logo for the tournament.
quiet: Each town in the valley has a small public library.
The children were allowed to choose some new books.
She finally opened a small bakery near the station.
Every student must bring a charged laptop to class.
The cat has a soft blanket by the fireplace.
Many families grow fresh vegetables in summer.
He prefers to cook simple meals after work.
Each team designs a colourful logo for the tournament.
